dataset.alt: CAMBER Dataset - Road Survey Video and Road Monitoring Route series (67 sibling Zenodo records); CAMBER Dataset – Road Survey Video #37
dataset.yearBasis: Year explicitly present in assessed-release description
dataset.img: 0.93-hour, 10.90-km survey. Two metadata files; payload via external/requested route.
dataset.lim: The Zenodo records are DOI landing pages only - each contains just 1-2 small metadata .txt files and the data payload is reachable only through expiring S3 presigned URLs, so long-term access is not assured; labels are unverified automatic YOLOv8 outputs rather than human ground truth; the class list duplicates pothole as both 'pothole' and 'potholes'; 66 sibling records were collapsed into this single row and are itemised in the Exclusion_Log [Claude] | Files restricted; linked S3 URLs are expired; location and data volume unresolved. [CodeX] Assessment covers Video 1 documentation only. Do not generalize the grade to all 67 sibling records.
